$comment: Fingerprints of our artifacts and of any real upstream. Paths are POSIX-style with forward slashes except the windowsLocalPrefix field. Run: node check-upstream.mjs
$commentKinds: THREE KINDS OF FILE, and the distinction is load-bearing. 'artifacts' (under agents) are theme files, installable and ours. 'buildInputs' are files the build READS, and their absence is a FAILURE. 'excludedFromBuild' are files the build does not read and will never read, kept on disk as EVIDENCE: their absence is the expected end state, not a broken dependency. A reader must never take an excluded reference for something required.
$commentPresence: PRESENCE, REQUIRED-NESS and COMMITTED-NESS are three separate facts, and this manifest keeps them apart on purpose. A file can be absent from a clone and still be required (a build input). A file can be present on disk and still not be committed (an excluded reference: kept locally, hash-pinned here, excluded by .gitignore). And an artifact's 'installed' flag describes the USER'S LIVE MACHINE, never this clone. The checker derives none of these from each other: the installed row is read from installPath and never from repoPath, so a clone that lacks a vendored file can never contradict installed:true.

buildInputs.purpose: Structural stub. Carries the 72-slot vocabulary the prototypes builder enumerates; every colour literal is a sentinel, and every key, nesting level and non-colour string is preserved from the template it was derived from. Derived programmatically, never hand-written.
buildInputs.provenance: ours - derived in-repo from our own template

buildInputs.purpose: Structural stub. Carries the 50-token theme vocabulary plus the two strings the emitter copies verbatim: the $schema URL, and background='none' (the terminal pass-through token, which is NOT a colour and survives the sentinel rewrite).
buildInputs.provenance: ours - derived in-repo from our own template

buildInputs.purpose: The real gentle-pi 3.7.0 upstream template, read from OUTSIDE the repo. Deliberately not stubbed: it is genuine upstream, its hash lives in agents.pi.upstreamFiles, and D8 left it exactly where it was.

Kept on disk as evidence of what the stub was derived from. The stub and this file are the same artefact from two sides, so the stub hash is what pins it.
excludedFromBuild.proofOfEquivalence: With the stub in place, all 8 emitted prototypes were byte-for-byte identical to the ones this template produced. Recorded in SOURCES.md under D8.

excludedFromBuildNote: ALL SIX files under material-trabajo/{claude-code,opencode,pi}/ are listed here, not just the two the prototypes build used to read. They are ONE category - base templates vendored from another project - and splitting them across two sections is what made the checker report MISSING for four files whose absence is perfectly legal. They are IGNORED, NOT DELETED: they stay on disk, each is hash-pinned here so the exclusion stays auditable, and .gitignore keeps them out of every commit. The matching artifact rows still carry the live-machine 'installed' flag, which is an independent fact read from installPath: a clone that lacks a vendored file is not evidence that the theme is not installed. Only 3 of the 6 have a real replacement; replacedBy:null on the other 3 is a stated fact, not a gap.
